title: Babble 01 is out: 10 speakers who talk in made up languages
body:
Babble 01 is live at $7.99. 650 dialogue sounds for text boxes in the babble style. As a line types out, the speaker talks in synthesised syllables instead of a beep, so the line sounds like speech in an invented language. 10 speakers, from a giant to a tiny trickster, each with its own consonants, its own vowels and its own twelve syllables, in 5 moods.

It is the second style of text advance audio, beside the tone beeps in Blip 01 and Blip 02. Same idea of one voice per speaker, with syllables in place of tones.

The hard part of babble is speed. A syllable on every letter at typing speed smears into a drone, which is the complaint left on the free pack this one improves on. So every speaker ships a stride table that says how many letters to skip at 30, 45 and 60 characters per second, and that is measured: three lines typed in every speaker and mood at all three speeds, 3175 of 3175 syllable boundaries dip clearly between syllables.

A letter map gives every letter a to z a syllable in each speaker's language, so a word sounds the same every time it appears. The moods are checked against the audio too: happy higher and quicker, angry brighter, sad lower and slower, a question rising at the end, 40 of 40 checks hold. The vowels come from a modelled vocal tract and land in the right order, 55 of 55 comparisons. All 45 pairs of speakers are separated in brightness or syllable length, so the cast is ten voices and not one voice at ten pitches. 20 more checks run against the exact zip a buyer downloads, including a blank Godot 4.7 project typing lines through the included helper node.

The honest limit: these are measurements of the signal. Nobody here has listened to the pack, so the page has a free demo with a preview line from every speaker and three complete speakers. Play those before you buy.

AI disclosure: the code that synthesises these sounds was written with AI assistance. The sounds are procedural synthesis in code, a glottal source and formant filters, with no generative audio or voice model. The cover and store images are AI generated.
